name: Route the Payment
tagline: Route the queue through the lower-fee provider.
brief: Process every payment by choosing the cheaper online provider.
context: Two reliable providers are online, and their only difference in this tutorial is the fee.
narrative:
YamusaPay has a queue of outgoing payments. Provider A and Provider B are both online and reliable, but they charge different fees.

Your controller receives the payment at the front of the queue and chooses a route. This first tutorial asks you to optimise one fact: fee.
objective: Process every payment with no failures and keep the total cost at or below ₦0.31.
learningObjective: Read provider facts and use one clear criterion to make a repeatable decision.
intelligenceExplanation:
The starting brain has no routing rules. Each tick exposes the current payment and provider facts.

In this fixed scenario, Provider B has the lower fee and stays online. Route each payment through B until the queue is empty.
hint: Create one rule: WHEN onlineB → DO route-b.
hints: Watch the queue on the right — each tick shows the payment at the head and each provider's fee.
A payment needs a routing rule: WHEN onlineB → DO route-b.
That single rule clears the queue, because B stays online and is the cheaper provider here.
